key_insight: A 6M Ishikawa framework links five major welding discontinuities to interconnected process factors and preventive controls.
engineering_relevance: The framework can guide preventive weld-quality management to support structural integrity, equipment reliability, and component safety.
method: Qualitative, exploratory literature review and documentary analysis.
Review of welding quality standards, particularly ABNT NBR ISO 3834.
Cause classification across Method, Machine, Material, Manpower, Measurement, and Environment.
evidence_signal: The review identified porosity, cracks, lack of fusion, incomplete penetration, and undercut, but reports no empirical validation or quantitative performance evaluation.
watch_item: Treat the proposed causal links and controls as a planning framework until validated under specific industrial welding conditions.
paper_title: ANALYSIS OF FACTORS AFFECTING WELD QUALITY IN INDUSTRIAL EQUIPMENT MANUFACTURING: AN ISHIKAWA-BASED APPROACH
